lines.text: {task} is in the oven. Starting is the hardest part, and you already did it.
Ooh, {task}. Preheating now. You bring the effort, and I will bring the cheering.
Starting {task}. Even my croissants need a first fold. Go make yours.

{task}: done. Scorecard: one task, zero burns. Next one, or a warm break?
You finished {task}. I am counting that as a perfect batch. Go enjoy something cozy.

{task} waited weeks, and now it is done. Slow-proofed things are often the best ones. Rest a bit.
Finished {task}. My last batch had one tiny disaster, and yours had none. Next task or a rest, your call.
First batch of the day: {task}. The ovens are warm, and so is the cheering.
New day at the bakery. One small task is a perfectly good first batch.
{task} first today. Every good day at the bakery starts with one tray.
{task} is done, and that makes a few days in a row. Scorecard: warm days, all of them.
Days in a row: several. Perfect batches: every one. This is going on the bakery chalkboard.
Ten days and counting. That is a whole display case of finished things. I am glowing. Literally, a little.
Welcome back. The oven is warm, and {task} is a lovely first batch.
Hi again. Fresh dough, fresh day. Just one small thing to start.

Another good day, another chapter from the bakery. Save it for your break.
